attributes.action: Arrest any person doing the Nazi salute
attributes.additional_details: The Nazi salute is illegal in Germany. It should be illegal in the UK
attributes.background: Recently, to many far right and fascist aggressors take great pleasure in doing the Nazi salute to show their hatred of everyone else. This was used by the German Nazi and has no place in the UK. People who do this should be arrested for inciting violence and need to be held accountable.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772101
